title: Fixing correct value for Legacy Subcontracting flag in Italy during u…
summary: Italian customers upgrading to version 28.3 regain access to legacy subcontracting pages by fixing the initialization of the Legacy Subcontracting flag in Manufacturing Setup.
key_points: After upgrade to 28.3, the Legacy Subcontracting flag was incorrectly set to False
This prevented Italian users from accessing legacy subcontracting functionality
The upgrade codeunit now properly initializes the flag to the correct value
